title: Implement a structured gameplay event log for every player action and game event in the Exolon Swift/SpriteKit game, and fix the wave-A fixed-tick/input/terminal state-machine audit findings it exposes: P1-9 (fixed-tick accumulator not reset on zone transition), P1-4 (jump latch fires after teleport while UP held), P1-8 (stage bonus re-triggers on final zone enabling score farm), P1-6 (double launcher permanently disabled after bonus collect). Regression tests per finding; logging must be cheap, structured, and testable.
